questions.context: A supplier delivered late, but the team had kept a backup. Ana says, “Had we relied on that delivery alone, we would have missed the launch”

options.text: The launch was actually missed because the delivery was late
A missed launch is presented as the consequence of an unreal past condition

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: Had we relied describes an alternative past, not what happened

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: Had we relied describes an alternative past, not what happened

previewOptions.text: A launch that was actually missed
An unreal condition and its result

questions.context: The backup was available. Kim says, “Without it, we might have had to postpone”
questions.prompt: How does might affect the claim?

options.text: It leaves postponement possible rather than certain in that alternative situation
It confirms that postponement definitely occurred

correct.title: Exactly
correct.message: Might have keeps the counterfactual result tentative

wrong.title: Check the context
wrong.message: Might have keeps the counterfactual result tentative

phrases.displayText: Looking back, what was the first warning sign?
phrases.translation: Olhando para trás, qual foi o primeiro sinal de alerta?

phrases.displayText: The delivery dates kept moving, but we assumed the supplier would catch up
phrases.translation: As datas de entrega continuavam sendo alteradas, mas presumimos que o fornecedor conseguiria cumprir o prazo

phrases.displayText: Had we checked their capacity earlier, we might have chosen a different partner
phrases.translation: Se tivéssemos verificado a capacidade deles antes, talvez tivéssemos escolhido um parceiro diferente

phrases.displayText: Perhaps, though I’m not sure that would have prevented every delay
phrases.translation: Talvez, embora eu não tenha certeza se isso teria evitado todos os atrasos

phrases.displayText: No. We also had no realistic contingency plan
phrases.translation: Não. Nós também não tínhamos um plano de contingência realista

phrases.displayText: That was the more serious oversight, in my view
phrases.translation: Na minha opinião, essa foi a falha mais grave

phrases.displayText: Would you call it the root cause?
phrases.translation: Você diria que é a causa raiz?

phrases.displayText: One of them. The other was that no one owned the final decision
phrases.translation: Uma delas. A outra era que ninguém detinha a responsabilidade pela decisão final

phrases.displayText: So the lesson isn’t simply to choose a better supplier
phrases.translation: Portanto, a lição não é simplesmente escolher um fornecedor melhor

phrases.displayText: Exactly. We need clearer responsibility and an alternative we can actually use
phrases.translation: Exatamente. Precisamos de responsabilidades mais claras e de uma alternativa que possamos realmente usar

phrases.displayText: Had I realised how much depended on that one delivery, I would have raised it sooner
phrases.translation: Se eu tivesse percebido o quanto dependia daquela única entrega, teria levantado a questão mais cedo

phrases.displayText: Then let’s make that dependency visible next time
phrases.translation: Então, vamos tornar essa dependência visível na próxima vez
